name: Water splash macro
description: The product caught in a splash of water with droplets frozen mid-air, hard rim light, dark backdrop. Use it for drinks, deodorants and anything that should read as fresh.
prompt: Product photograph: the product in image 1, unchanged in shape, colour and label, at the instant of a water splash, with droplets and arcing water frozen mid-air around it. Hard rim light from behind with a {{ accent }} glow, dark seamless backdrop, macro sharpness on the label, natural refraction where the water crosses the product. {{#if extra}}{{ extra }}.{{/if}} No text, no watermark.
negative_prompt: blurry, duplicated product, warped label, text, watermark, hands, muddy water

slots.name: extra
slots.label: Extra direction
slots.help: e.g. 'a slice of lime caught in the splash'
